env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
cd a
logos run .
stdout '^ok$'
logos eject -o ../out
exists ../out/main.go
! exists ../out/main.lgo
cd ../out
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1273/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.3 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go build -o probe .
exec ./probe
stdout '^ok$'

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/selectassigntarget

go 1.27

-- a/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

type target struct {
	value int
	ok bool
	calls int
}

func (s *target) after(c chan int) *target {
	if len(c) != 0 {
		panic("target evaluated before comm receive")
	}
	s.calls++
	return s
}

func blocked(ctx context.Context, c chan int, index chan int, s *target) error {
	bools := []bool{false}
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			select {
			case s.after(c).value, bools[<-index] = <-c:
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
func run() error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	index := make(chan int, 1)
	a := []int{0}
	s := &target{}
	c <- 11
	index <- 0
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			select {
			case a[<-index] = <-c:
			}
		}
	}
	if a[0] != 11 || len(index) != 0 {
		panic("index receive target")
	}
	c <- 23
	index <- 0
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			select {
			case a[<-index], s.ok = <-c:
			}
		}
	}
	if a[0] != 23 || !s.ok {
		panic("two-value index target")
	}
	c <- 37
	index <- 0
	bools := []bool{false}
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			select {
			case s.after(c).value, bools[<-index] = <-c:
			}
		}
	}
	if s.value != 37 || !bools[0] || s.calls != 1 {
		panic("two-value selector order")
	}
	cancelCtx, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	stop()
	index <- 0
	err := blocked(cancelCtx, c, index, s)
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || s.calls != 1 || len(index) != 1 {
		panic("canceled comm evaluated target")
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok")
}
